# snappy: source provenance

Authors: Marc Culler, Nathan Dunfield, Matthias Goerner, Jeff Weeks and contributors.

Source: https://github.com/3-manifolds/SnapPy/tree/c3da53c2b3105489b4d71531c4f781c92b237753

License: GPL-2.0-or-later.

Original hyperboloid camera movement, Lorentz utility calculations and ideal-tetrahedron ray data. These modules require the pinned SnapPy package; their O(1,3) conventions must be read before reuse.

Each copied upstream file is preserved without editing. See ../sources.tsv for original paths, Git blob identities and sizes. Only selected files are present; dependency closure is not claimed. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
